title: Coronagraph Watch
text:
🔭 Coronagraph Watch — September 28, 2026

There’s a new CME in NASA’s DONKI, so Sunny is looking at the corona.

☀️ CME start: September 27, 2026 at 21:00 UTC
💨 CME speed: 362 km/s
🏷 CME SCORE: S-type (<500 km/s)
📐 CME half-angle: 10° (Narrow)

Eyes on the corona today. 👀☀️

Image: NOAA SWPC — LASCO C3
Data: NASA DONKI + NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
